canon_requests.new: 2a. **Errata in solo play only:** if Death's Door did not prevent the lethal damage and the last stand is unused this Folio, the Erratum enters a last stand of 300 ticks (doc 04 §12.1a) with HP 0, taking no damage. On success its HP = 1,000 mHP; on failure step 3 applies.
Second Edition Folio `n` (n ≥ 1) uses depth `25 + 2n` in the P, T, H and S tables.
